paite: Noplen ka hi kei a hia? Sawltak kei a hia? I Toupa Jesu ka muta kei a hia? Noute Toupa a ka nasep gah na hi kei ua hia?
heading: Sawltakte Thuneih Leh Hamphatna
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

paite: Midangte a ding in sawltak hi kei mah leng, noute a ding bek in zaw ka hi; Toupa a ka sawltak hihna chiamtehna noumau na hi uhi.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

paite: Hiai kei hon demte ka dawn na ahi,
english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

paite: Ne ding leh dawn ding in thu ka nei kei ua hia?
english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

paite: Sawltak dangte leh Toupa unaute leh Kifas bang in zi gingtami pi vialvial ding in thu ka nei kei ua hia?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

paite: Ahihkeileh kei leh Barnabas kia koumau kivak kawm a khut a nna sem lou ding in thu ka nei lou tuam ua hia?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

paite: Sepaih kua ahia amah kivak a galkap ngei? Kua'n ahia agah ne lou a grephuan bawl ngei? Ahihkeileh kua'n ahia ganhon nawitui ne lou a ganhon vul ngei?
english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

paite: Huai thute mihing bang mai in ka gen a hia? Dan thu mah in leng huai ngei agen sam kei a hia?
english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

paite: Mosi Dan Laibu ah, "Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk gak ke'n," chih gelh ahi. Pathian in bawngtal a ding kia hia angaihtuahsak?
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

paite: Ahihkeileh ei a ding a kigen ahi hia? Hi e, ei a ding a agelh ahi; lei letpa'n lamet nei a aleh ding ahi a, buhvopa'n leng tan neih sam lamen a avuak ding ahi.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

paite: Koute'n khalam thilte na kiang ua ka tuh ngal uleh, na salam thilte uh at le ung leng thil thupi ahi dia hia?
english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

paite: Midang in bawn na tung ua thuneihna atan uleh kou tang sem lou ding ka hi uh maw? Himahleh huai thuneihna ka zang kei uh; Khrist tanchinhoih ka dallouhna ding un bangkim ka thuak teitei uhi.
english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

paite: Tempul a thil siangthou bawl vialvialte'n tempul a kipan nek amu ua, maitam a nasemte'n maitam a pan ane uh chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

paite: Huchi mah bang in, Toupa'n tanchinhoih gente nek muhna ding in tanchinhoih mah asep hi.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

paite: Himahleh ke'n zaw tuate khat leng ka zang kei hi; ka tung a hiaite na hih ding uh ahi chi a hiai thu gelh ka hi kei hi. Kuapeuh in ka suan pen bangmah lou a abawl sang un, si mai leng kei a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

paite: Tanchinhoih gen mah leng kisaktheihna ding ahi kei hi. Hih louh theih louh ka tung ah akinga ahi; tanchinhoih gen kei leng ka tung gik ding ahi.
english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

paite: Huai tuh keimah ut thu a hih hi leng kipahman ka nei hi; himahleh, keimah ut thu ahihkeileh tanchinhoih kepna nna piak a om ka hi.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

paite: Ka kipahman bang ahia le? Tanchinhoih ka gen in loh nei lou a, tanchinhoih athawn a pia ka hihtheihna ahi.
english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

paite: Mi teng a pan zalen himah leng, mi tamsem ka laktheihna ding in mi tengteng sikha in ka kibawlta hi.
heading: Khrist Sikha A Kipiakna
english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

paite: Huchi in Judate ka laklut theihna ding in Judate kiang ah Juda mi bang in ka om zel; dan nuai a omte ka laklut theihna ding in dan nuai a omte kiang ah dan nuai a om bang in ka om zel; dan nuai a om tuan lou in.
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

paite: Dan neiloute ka laklut theihna ding in dan neiloute kiang ah dan nei lou bang in ka om zel, Pathian dan a om lou tuan lou in; Khrist dan zom ngal in.
english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

paite: Hatloute ka laklut theihna ding in hatloute kiang ah hat lou bang in ka om zel; hihtheihna teng zang a khenkhatte ka hotdam theihna ding in mi tengteng kiang ah bangkim ka hita hi.
english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

paite: Tanchinhoih ziak in bangkim ka hih zel a, huai nasepna a ka tel sam theihna ding in.
english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

paite: Kitaitehte avek un atai ua, himahleh khat kia in kipahman amu zel chih na thei kei ua hia? Na muhtheihna ding un huchi mah bang in tai un.
heading: Vualzou Ding A Kisukna
english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

paite: Huan kidemna a kimawl mi peuhmah bangkim ah mahni kithunun in a-om nak hi. Amau zaw lallukhu se thei mu ding in ahih ua, eite'n bel Lallukhu Setheilou mu ding in.
english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

paite: Huaiziak in kei ka tai a, aziak bei hilou in; huihkhua leltak noh lou in ka pang hi.
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

paite: Himahleh ka pumpi ka thunun a; sikha in ka bawl zaw zel hi; huchi lou in zaw midangte kiang a ka tangkoupih nung in leng bangchi hiam in kei ngeitak kipahman mu tak lou in ka om kha ding hi.
english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.
